newsitem.title: UK: UK Ecu 3-month bills' highest yield falls.
newsitem.headline: UK Ecu 3-month bills' highest yield falls.

text.p: The highest accepted yield at Tuesday's auction of 500 million Ecu of three-month Treasury bills fell to 4.18 percent from last month's 4.39 percent, the Bank of England said.
That compares with an average yield of 4.17, the BOE said.
The highest accepted yield for the 200 million Ecu offer of one-month bills fell to 4.17 percent from 4.35 percent last month and compares with an average yield of 4.17 percent.
The auction of 300 million Ecu of six-month bills produced a highest accepted yield of 4.19 percent, down from 4.33 percent last month and against an average yield of 4.18 percent.
The three-part tender totalling one billion Ecu met applications of 2.982 billion Ecu and was allotted in full.
As announced in its tender notice dated September 3 the Bank took an additional 50 million Ecu of bills onto its own books.
The next Ecu tender will be on October 8, the Bank said. Details will be released on October 1.
